$schema_note: Hand-curated record of how Hero Siege announces a rare ground drop in chat, for ForgePact#17 (Loot announcements). NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file. Every entry carries its own `status`: `static_reading` (read from the compiled game locally and paraphrased in our own words; no script text is kept anywhere), `inference`, `not_established`, or `measured` (only `route.status`, from ForgePact#17's Live procedure 3). `scripts` is the announcement chain by SDK name, in call order. `rarity_key` is the itemInfoStruct key the closure is taken to read: that key "27" holds the rarity is measured (docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 16.4), but that the closure reads it is an inference from the codes it compares, because the key strings were not read. `rarity_codes_in_closure` lists every rarity code the closure compares on a branch of its own, and for each whether the online path announces it; the list is what was read, and `announced_online` is `not_established` where the reading does not say. `route` is the call ForgePact's `lootann` ships to show the line offline: `server` (chosen 2026-10-04 after Live procedures 1 and 3; the game's own path, `method`, could not be tested offline (the probe's anon control did not resolve)). The argument is ForgePact docs/loot-announcement-research.md; the shared facts are docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md sections 8.6 and 16.10.

scripts.name: gml_Script_anon@1138@gml_Object_Loot_Ground_obj_Create_0
scripts.role: the announcement closure bound on each Loot_Ground_obj; no arguments; reads the item's rarity and branches per rarity

scripts.name: gml_Script_GetRareDropAnnouncement
scripts.role: is this drop announced: true for rarity 7 or 10, and for a few material and socketable ids

scripts.name: gml_Script_NetworkSendChatMessageIngame
scripts.role: called by the closure with (a runtime global, 18687, item, colour, int64 3); builds the line, adds it locally, sends it inside a block whose condition was not read

scripts.name: gml_Script_GetItemDropMessage
scripts.role: the localized line naming the item, when the sender's last argument is 3

scripts.name: gml_Script_ChatAddMessage
scripts.role: adds the built line to the chat feed (15 arguments)

scripts.name: gml_Script_PacketSend
scripts.role: the network send inside the sender's conditional block

rarity_key.note: itemInfoStruct["27"] holding the rarity is measured (section 16.4); that the closure reads that key is inferred from the codes it compares (7, 10, 9, 6), the key strings were not read

rarity_codes_in_closure.decided_by: the closure itself (gml_Script_anon@1138@gml_Object_Loot_Ground_obj_Create_0); gml_Script_GetRareDropAnnouncement was not read answering true for 9
rarity_codes_in_closure.note: the branch is a static reading; whether that branch announces a Heroic drop online was not read, and what the closure does after a false GetRareDropAnnouncement answer depends on a value whose meaning is not established (the same position as Satanic). ForgePact announces it (the owner's scope)

rarity_codes_in_closure.decided_by: not established: gml_Script_GetRareDropAnnouncement was not read answering true for 6, and what the closure does after a false answer depends on a value whose meaning is not established
rarity_codes_in_closure.note: the branch is a static reading; whether a Satanic drop is announced online is not established. ForgePact does not announce it (the owner's scope: Heroic, Angelic, Unholy)

route.name: server
route.sink: ChatAddServerMessage by name with '<character> found <item name>' (itemInfoStruct["28"], the player's name), the red SERVER: line
route.why: the game's own path (method, the anon@1138 closure) was not reachable to test this session: the probe's anon control did not resolve (`anon rows resolved: 0 of 2`, instrument-blind), so whether the closure is bound on the ground item is not established; server ships per the owner's rule (route-method-2 not pass).
